title: Mac n Cheese

ingredients.item: salt, plus more for the pasta water

steps: Boil the macaroni in well-salted water until 1 minute short of the package time. Reserve ½ cup of pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1–2 minutes until it smells nutty, without letting it brown.
Whisk in the warm milk a splash at a time at first to avoid lumps. Simmer, stirring, for 4–5 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Take the pot off the heat. Stir in the mustard powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper, then add the cheeses a handful at a time until smooth.
Fold in the macaroni. Loosen with a splash of pasta water if needed — the sauce thickens as it sits.
Serve immediately with a pinch of smoked paprika. For a crunchy top, move it to a baking dish, scatter over extra cheese and breadcrumbs, and grill for 2–3 minutes.
